_mod_info: This file controls the competitor companies in the game. Edit it to add your own! The game picks randomly from this list each playthrough. Only 'name' is required — everything else is optional and the game will fill in defaults.

_format.name: Company name (required)
_format.focus: One of: saas, consumer, marketplace, dev_tools (optional, random if missing)
_format.size: One of: startup, growth, enterprise (optional — controls starting strength)

_modding_tips: Want to use real company names? Just edit this file. Share your version with others by hosting it anywhere (GitHub Pages, Pastebin, etc). To restore defaults, delete this file and the game will recreate it.
